author: TeIq
content: Implemented. Migration 39 adds scheduled_takedowns table with PENDING/EXECUTED/CANCELLED CHECK constraint. api/scheduled_takedowns.rs exposes POST (schedule), DELETE (cancel), GET (list). Background worker scheduled_takedown_worker polls every 60s, fires up to 50 schedules/cycle via SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, materialises each as an actions row of kind=takedown in one transaction. 3 integration tests pass (schedule, past-rejection, cancel-idempotence with conflict on double). 532 lib tests pass; clippy -D warnings clean.
